title: pr wait refuses a draft PR; pr create, ready and comment retry GitHub 5xx safely
notes: Retro 2026-11-26. (1) pr wait on a draft PR can wait forever: CI skips drafts, and pull-request-cli.ts never mentions drafts. It should refuse straight away, saying the PR is a draft. (2) Workers retry GitHub 502 and GraphQL errors by hand, and the retries are unsafe: 17 errors across 6 sessions; one gh pr create failed 5 times and then hit 'a pull request already exists'. Add pr create, pr ready and pr comment verbs to the dashboard command (src/main/command/pull-request-cli.ts) that retry 5xx with backoff and check state first (an existing PR for the branch, ready already). Point work-card and the review prompts at them instead of raw gh.

comments.body: Overlap: card dbec2149 (Review workers run their set-up and wrap-up inside pr-loop, branch review-workers-run-their-set-up-and-wrap-up, no commits yet) moves the review worker's gh pr ready --undo, start/finish comments and CI wait into pr-loop or the review dispatch. This card points the review prompts at new pr ready / pr comment verbs. Both touch src/main/ship/review.ts (the review prompt, lines ~170-200) and the same draft/comment steps; this card also changes src/main/command/pull-request-cli.ts and src/main/skills/work-card-skill.ts. Waiting on main for go on / stop.
